svg.text: Enterprise RL post-training (slime fork) - Two-plane rollout/train + production stability layer
L3 - Two-Plane Core Architecture (inherited from slime)
TP / PP / EP / CP - varlen thd packing
Bridge between rollout and train planes
Speculative decoding + online SFT draft model
Zero-copy weight sync: CUDA IPC mapping + bucketed flatten (50% faster vs HTTP/RPC)
L4 - Enterprise Stability Layer (Miles additions over slime)
MoE Stability: R3 + Unified FP8 + QAT
Systems-first: eliminate train-inference mismatch that collapses trillion-param MoE RL
Same FP8 quant path in SGLang rollout and Megatron backprop - bit-identical policies
INT4 W4A16 QAT: 1TB models on single H200 - 2x rollout efficiency (no cross-node infer)
Fallback: TIS/MIS importance sampling when mismatch unavoidable - prevent divergence
Dense alignment: SGLang logprobs match Megatron/FSDP via kernel-level deterministic forward
Roadmap: zero mismatch MoE - aligning SGLang with Megatron expert dispatch natively
Small core, many edges - swap behavior via CLI without forking Miles
Step 1: Rollout plane generates via SGLang + Miles Router (custom rollout-function-path)
Step 2: Reward scoring (custom-rm-path) - filter - store in rollout buffer with R3 metadata
Step 3: Training plane GRPO/PPO update (megatron or fsdp) - compute advantages - ppo_update
Step 4: Zero-copy weight refit to SGLang (CUDA IPC + bucketed gather) - loop
Built on slime core: Megatron pretrain - Miles post-train - SGLang deploy (shared ckpt path)
Observability: Chrome trace profiling + Grafana dashboards + adaptive data weighting
Docker radixark/miles - NVLink/IB/RDMA optimized - NVIDIA + AMD ROCm MI300/350 - InfiXAI / Ant / SGLang RL Team
Init path: Ray cluster - deploy rollout engines + train workers - init buffer - load HF/Megatron ckpt - Miles Router
Step path: SGLang generate (R3 record) - reward - buffer - GRPO train - zero-copy sync - metrics - ckpt - repeat
Sources: radixark/miles README - miles_server_args.md - LMSYS Miles/FP8/INT4 blogs - R3 paper arXiv:2510.11370 - slime fork
